e: A cyberattack is carried out on refrigeration systems of supermarkets across seven European countries including Luxembourg, resulting in financial losses caused by food spoilage.
A drone sighting shuts down Luxembourg Airport.
Ukraine repatriates the remains of nationalist leader Andriy Melnyk and his wife Sofia from Bonnevoie cemetery for an official reburial in Kyiv.
A French real estate agent is stabbed to death by a 27-year Belgian client in Limpertsberg, provoking a large-scale police operation.
